What is the best fertilizer for paddy in clay soil?
11:54 AM
🌾 **Paddy in Clay / Heavy Soils:**

• **Basal Dose:** Apply 50% Nitrogen (Urea), full dose of Single Super Phosphate (SSP 60kg/ha), 75% MOP, and 25 kg Zinc Sulfate/ha during final puddling.
• **Top Dressing:** 25% Nitrogen at active tillering (21-25 days) + 25% Nitrogen at panicle initiation.
• **Water Management:** Maintain 3-5 cm standing water during vegetative tillering. Drain 10 days before harvest.
